cards.name: Burning Earth
cards.text: Whenever a player taps a nonbasic land for mana, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that player.

cards.name: Manabarbs
cards.text: Whenever a player taps a land for mana, this enchantment deals 1 damage to that player.

cards.name: Overabundance
cards.text: Whenever a player taps a land for mana, that player adds one mana of any type that land produced, and this enchantment deals 1 damage to the player.
